title: Refuse a system case whose build requirement is missing
goal: An unmet built-browser-assets requirement stops the case with its reason instead of a failed ledger entry
acceptance: A committed test fails before the fix: without dist/web/browser the browser case is recorded as failed
The wrapper names the unmet requirement and writes no ledger entry for that case
With a build present the case runs as before
escalation: A change to what the ledger counts as covered goes to a fresh-context review

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13: one requirement check and one test. Not a measurement.
